newsitem.title: UK: Britain introduces wildfowl shooting ban.
newsitem.headline: Britain introduces wildfowl shooting ban.

text.p: Britain said on Thursday it would ban the shooting of some wild birds because cold weather was threatening their survival.
The temporary ban, starting on Friday, covers ducks, geese and shore waders which cannot feed because of frozen conditions.
It will run until January 24, at least, and will not be lifted until there have been at least seven days without frost.
Under rules drawn up in 1982, a ban on shooting wildfowl -- a favourite country sport in Britain -- should be considered if there has been frost for 13 days.
Most of Britain has been freezing for the last three weeks and a thaw is not expected before next week at the earliest.
